info.task_name: Recreate bouncing squares animation with MoviePy
info.task_summary: The agent must reverse-engineer a reference video of 12 colored squares bouncing diagonally with shrinking walls, and reproduce it algorithmically using MoviePy primitives in scene.py. The rendered output.mp4 must match reference.mp4.
